title: The admission wait had no real deadline: a hung read blocked it, and an admission read after the deadline passed
resolution: Each read runs in the background and is killed at the deadline; no read starts after it, and a late admission is a timeout; tests cover both.

title: A bound with a leading zero was read as octal, so 08 failed and 010 meant 8 seconds
resolution: The bound is converted in base 10; tests cover 08 and 010.

title: The record and the tasks still called make verify, the Docker gate, and the integration checks not run
resolution: The coordinator's runs on 431d1ddf are recorded in their own section and the tasks ticked; the author checks stay as they ran.
